description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) of different anomaly detection models across various datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, which include SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis indicates the F1 Score, ranging from 60% to 100%. The chart includes four groups of bars, each representing a different configuration of the MADLLM model: MADLLM with feature embedding, MADLLM with prompt pool, MADLLM with skip embedding, and MADLLM without prompt pool. The bars are color-coded, with each color corresponding to a specific model configuration. The F1 Scores vary across the datasets and model configurations, with some models performing better on certain datasets than others. The chart does not include any additional annotations or visual emphasis on specific bars.
